{
  "name": "sc-accounts",
  "displayName": "SimpleCORE Accounts",
  "version": "0.5.2",
  "license": "MIT",
  "description": "Switch between saved Claude logins and watch every account's rate limits",
  "author": {
    "name": "SimpleCORE",
    "email": "dev@simplecore.kr"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/simplecore-inc/claude-mods/blob/main/docs/accounts.md",
  "repository": "https://github.com/simplecore-inc/claude-mods",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "account-switcher",
    "multi-account",
    "usage-limits",
    "rate-limits",
    "statusline",
    "status-band",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "showStatusBand": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Show the status band",
      "description": "Show the session status (model, context, account usage, place, lines changed) on the band above the prompt",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
